messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — need to lock the launch slice + acceptance criteria for the unified API surfaces (chat/completions, embeddings, rerank). Doc: https://redwood.internal/specs/unified-api-draft (please review).
Liam Chen: skimmed the doc. main ask: what are the latency SLOs per endpoint for GA? we need numbers for SLA and load tests.
Anika Gomez: proposal in the doc: chat/completions 95th <= 200ms, embeddings <= 150ms, rerank 95th <= 300ms. these are host-mode targets, dedicated gets tighter.
Ravi Singh: those look okay but rerank 300ms depends on batch size. need a fallback path when quantized model causes quality regression.
Jordan Brooks: SDK impacts: clients will need new param for "variant" routing + optional client_hints for expected latency/cost. example: 
```json
{ "model": "redwood-chat-1", "variant": "high-accuracy", "hints": {"max_latency_ms": 200} }
```
Maya Patel: good. acceptance criteria draft:
- API contract stable (no breaking param changes)
- end-to-end e2e tests for chat+embed+rerank with canary rollout
- documented fallback behavior when rerank unavailable (return unranked results + warn header)
- perf: meet SLO on synthetic traffic 95th for target slice
Liam Chen: add quality gating: for rerank we need a small evaluation harness that checks top-1 swap rate <= 3% vs baseline model on the seed prompt set.
Anika Gomez: agreed. also include embedding cosine stability: mean delta < 0.02 for pinned dataset after quantization.
Ravi Singh: cost control: recommend default variant = high-throughput (quantized) on hosted free-tier, opt-in high-accuracy for paying customers. mention autoscale behavior.
Maya Patel: product question: which customers get early access? we have 3 pilots that asked for deterministic rerank + per-route analytics. propose pilot gating: pilot customers -> dedicated biz tier -> private.
Jordan Brooks: rollout plan: feature flag + canary to 5% for two days, monitor 95th latency, error rate, and quality regressions. SDKs: add a minor version bump and changelog entry.
Liam Chen: edge cases to call out in PRD: very long contexts (>= 32k tokens) -> embeddings should return truncated vector + header "x-redwood-truncated: true"; rerank should fallback to chunk-level scoring.
Anika Gomez: also list: malformed embedding requests (non-number float arrays) -> return 400 with example error payload; and empty chat messages -> return 422 with guidance.
Ravi Singh: infra note: need KV cache eviction policy tuned for rerank session affinity; otherwise we see latency spikes. assigned to eng-runtime
Maya Patel: okay owners: product=Maya, eng=Ravi, SDK=Jordan, QA=Liam, research=Anika. next steps:
- Ravi: upload perf numbers by EOD Tue.
- Jordan: draft SDK PR and changelog by Wed.
- Liam: create eval harness repo + baseline scripts.
- Anika: add quantization acceptance tests to the spec.
Maya Patel: any blockers? @Ravi?
Ravi Singh: one: model onboarding for rerank needs re-tokenization script update; might slip if we don't freeze model list.
Maya Patel: can we do a hard freeze for GA candidate models next Tue?
Ravi Singh: yes, if research signs off today.
Anika Gomez: signing off on candidate list after I run the embedding stability sweep tonight. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deploy check: no active deploys; queue clear.
Maya Patel: great — I'll update the PRD with these acceptance bullets and owners, then ping infra + customers for pilot opt-ins. Thanks all. :pray:
